# Study 039: Magus of the Wheel into jaws-v1. deck-doctor, MODE prescribe
RECOMMENDATION: Magus of the Wheel IN, Valeria Richards, Precocious OUT (contested). The goldfish reads it as a trade, not a clear upgrade. What decides it is the pilot's own plan: Magus is a permanent, a Human that Shabraz can give flying, and a wheel on a body. That answers "too many wheels, not enough permanent spells" without adding another sorcery. Run it after the open question below is cleared.
SIZE OF IT: Magus wins back about +0.2 of the 1.6 wheels-by-T10 that jaws-v1 lost (3.4 -> 1.8). Damage @T10 is a no call on every screen (+1 to +4 against the 97-point drop). One body does not undo six wheel cuts. If "fast, frenzied" is meant to bring back V14's damage, it takes more than one card.
SCREENS (try --branch jaws-v1, 10,000 paired games, Holm across 18 rows; "now -> swapped"):
- OUT Valeria: 8 better / 3 worse / 7 no call. Finisher wheel by T8 60.3% -> 65.0% [+4.2, +5.1] Better. Wheels by T10 +0.19 [+0.18, +0.21] Better. Extra cards by T8 +1.0 [+0.8, +1.1] Better. Killed by T6 +0.3 pts [+0.1, +0.5] Better. Stall -0.3 pts [-0.5, -0.1] Better. Damage @T10 +1.1 [-2.0, +4.2] no call. Worse: keep rule -1.4 pts [-1.7, -1.2], cards handed out +0.81 [+0.75, +0.87], dead wheels +0.006. All three come from Magus itself; they show up on every screen.
- OUT Willie Lumpkin: 6 / 7 / 5. Same Magus gains. Hoard @T10 +0.49 [+0.18, +0.79] Better. Worse: stall +0.6 pts [+0.4, +0.8], missed drop +0.6 [+0.4, +0.8], cards seen -0.1. The goldfish cannot see his "that player can't attack you" clause. That defence is what game 009 lacked when the whole table swung in.
- OUT Brainstorm: 3 / 6 / 9, the weakest screen. Missed drop +1.0 pts [+0.8, +1.2] Worse. Cards seen by T5 -0.4 [-0.4, -0.3] Worse. Damage +4.2 [+0.2, +8.3] does not survive Holm.
- OUT Faerie Mastermind: 7 / 5 / 6. Hoard @T10 +0.88 [+0.63, +1.12] Better. Stall +0.5 pts [+0.3, +0.7] Worse. Cut it last. Log 009 has it "kept everybody drawing". Its trigger pays off on Magus (each opponent draws seven, so you draw). It is also a flash flying blocker. The goldfish has no opponents and no combat against us, so it prices neither the payoff nor the blocking.
WHY VALERIA: its screen is the only one where every worse row is Magus's own cost. Valeria is a 4-mana ground Human with no evasion. Its cost reduction never touches Magus's ability, which is an activation, not a spell. Willie and Mastermind both do things the goldfish cannot see: politics, blocking, and the opponent-draw payoff.
WHAT VALERIA COSTS: a {1} discount on every noncreature spell (wheels, protection, Will of the Jeskai) and about one card a turn. That lowers the extra-card floor on turns with no wheel. It is also one less Human that draws.
NOT AFFECTED: no keep list (protected.json is absent, deleted 2026-11-25). None of the pilot's 2026-11-25 keeps is touched. Land count unchanged; no land is cut. Colour sources unchanged.
COMBOS: no two-card infinite. Magus is in no included line and no one-short ("near") line in jaws-v1's combos.json or V14's. V14 ran Magus with 0 known lines. With Bard or Teferi's Ageless Insight, a Magus wheel draws 14. That is a big turn, not a loop.
COSTS THE GOLDFISH CALLS: "cards handed to each opponent by T8" +0.8. jaws-v1 halved this on purpose, and the A table (Purphoros, Krenko, Tiny Bones) is the table that cashes those cards in. Keep rule -1.4 pts.
OPEN QUESTION (settled_by: goldfish, then forge-cast-check): try shows Magus as "cast-check UNPLAYED". Run `forge-cast-check sharknado --branch jaws-v1 --card "Magus of the Wheel"` before any Forge arm.
GOLDFISH BLIND SPOTS: no blockers, no removal, no opponents casting. Magus as a 3/3 blocker, the wheel refilling opponents' hands, and Willie's or Mastermind's defence are all unpriced. Every damage row is a ceiling.
